svg.title: The controller's feedback loop
svg.desc: A feedback loop, left to right. Tag 1: a box, goal. An arrow goes to a dashed box, the node go_to_goal, which holds two boxes: errors(), tag 2, which gives rho and alpha, and _control(), tag 3, which gives v and omega. An arrow goes from _control() through the topic /cmd_vel to tag 4, a box: Gazebo, the robot. From Gazebo an arrow goes down and back left through the topic /odom, tag 5, up into errors().
